# Boliden bryter ny mark – strålande resultat från Elekta

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode is mostly about Boliden's roughly SEK 13bn share-financed purchase of a majority stake in Nexa Resources, a zinc producer. The deal gives Boliden Votorantim as a new 7% Brazilian lead owner, and editor Anders Hägerstrand calls the strategy sensible but flags governance, debt and geographic risks. The episode also covers Elekta's report (stronger margins, weaker growth), Nvidia's report and the guest's view that Nvidia's competitors are better buys, plus a strong Nordrest report. The market mood is cautiously positive overall, but the Boliden deal gets a sceptical reception.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 BOL — Boliden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host positive on zinc tilt and share-funded deal but flags governance, debt and South America risks; analysts sceptical; stock -2.6%.

#### Reasoning

Hägerstrand likes the zinc tilt over copper (zinc has lagged) and says a share-paid deal protects Swedish capex. He also sees long-term governance questions with a foreign lead owner who may build a larger stake, more debt from Nexa, and mining cost-overrun risk. Ålandsbanken and Danske are sceptical. Mixed view, so watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- Votorantim builds stake toward 10-15% and challenges governance
- Nexa assets need capital injections
- Swedish expansion projects deprioritised
- Debt rises to concerning levels

> *"Boliden för en utländsk ägare, det är en sån som man ska vara vaksam på. Men vi ska ändå vara positiva i grunden till att svenska bolag expanderar"*

---

### 🟠 EKTA-B — Elekta | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Profitability beat; strong orders, 2-4% guide reiterated, inventory build signals delivery; China weak.

#### Reasoning

SP1 analyst Johan Unérus says orders came in strong and margins improved from service/software mix, tariffs and cost savings. Guidance was reiterated and the inventory build points to a good delivery outlook in Asia/China and a US ramp for Evo. The concern is China's procurement shift toward local and low-cost alternatives. Stock fell up to 4%.

#### Sell Triggers

- China orders deteriorate on centralised low-cost procurement
- Growth guide 2-4% cut
- US Evo ramp stalls

> *"man sparar och gör det mesta ganska bra men just osäkerheten över Kina och orderingången"*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

70% growth guide for next year, still 80-85% of AI chips; but gross margin guided down, competition in inference, lags peers.

#### Reasoning

Guest Herman Olsson notes strong visibility and demand, but whisper numbers were missed. The risk profile is shifting toward financing neoclouds, gross margins are guided down and inference is more cost-competitive. He prefers the competitor value chain over Nvidia itself.

#### Sell Triggers

- Further gross margin guide-downs
- Neocloud financing risk materialises
- Inference share loss to cheaper chips

> *"det kanske finns andra större vinnare just nu än Nvidia"*

---

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest's fund owns; Nvidia competitor chain has outperformed and should keep being owned.

#### Reasoning

Olsson argues inference favours good-enough, cheaper chips. He says Nvidia's competitor value chain has done better than Nvidia this year and should continue to be owned.

#### Sell Triggers

- Nvidia regains share in inference
- AI capex slowdown

> *"Vi äger ju AMD, Intel, Mediatek till exempel. Även Arista Network ... Och det tror jag man ska fortsätta äga."*

---

### 🟢 INTC — Intel | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's fund owns as part of Nvidia competitor chain; recommends continuing to own.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis: competition in inference and the competing value chain outperforming Nvidia.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex slowdown
- Competitive position in inference fails

> *"Vi äger ju AMD, Intel, Mediatek till exempel."*

---

### 🟢 2454 — MediaTek | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's fund owns; competitor chain to Nvidia recommended to keep owning.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis: competing AI value chain outperforming Nvidia, with cost-driven inference demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex slowdown

> *"Vi äger ju AMD, Intel, Mediatek till exempel."*

---

### 🟢 ANET — Arista Networks | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's fund owns network equipment maker; outperformed Nvidia, keep owning.

#### Reasoning

Olsson thinks hardware/infrastructure will keep doing well regardless of model risks. Arista is part of the outperforming AI value chain.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI infrastructure spending slows

> *"Även Arista Network som gör nätverksutrustning. Alla de bolagen har gått väsentligt mycket bättre än vad Nvidia gjort i år."*

---

### 🟠 CRM — Salesforce | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Order growth slightly accelerating, higher value per order, Anthropic partnership; software trend improving.

#### Reasoning

Guest says software has started to rise this summer and that any sign of acceleration is very positive. The Anthropic plugin partnership drove a ~14% move.

#### Sell Triggers

- Order growth re-decelerates
- AI disruption hits sales

> *"minsta tecken på att man ser någon form av acceleration är såklart väldigt positivt för de här bolagen, som till exempel Salesforce"*

---

### 🟠 NREST — Nordrest | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Record Q2, sales +16.2%; Pareto expects next quarter stronger despite tougher comps; defence tailwind.

#### Reasoning

Pareto (cited analyst) sees an even stronger next quarter. The company benefits from the defence theme via military catering. The initial +5% faded to about +1%.

#### Sell Triggers

- Next quarter misses Pareto expectations
- Defence enthusiasm fades

> *"jag läste att Pareto tror att nästa kvartal kommer bli ännu starkare"*
